unsupported_requirements: Native Windows windows-execenv tests and installer tests under Windows PowerShell 5.1 and 7 are required.
Native macOS macos-runtime tests and BSD shell installer tests are required.
GitHub path-filter and frontend/backend aggregate job acceptance require coordinator readback; this entry runs every portable scope.

checks.name: toolchain
checks.command:
test "$(node --version | cut -d. -f1)" = v22
test "$(pnpm --version)" = 10.28.2
go version | grep -E "go1\.26\."
command -v docker
command -v helm

checks.name: sqlc
checks.command:
make sqlc
git diff --exit-code -- server/pkg/db/generated
test -z "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- server/pkg/db/generated)"

checks.name: frontend-build
checks.command: pnpm exec turbo build typecheck lint --force --filter='!@multica/docs' --filter='!@multica/mobile'

checks.name: scripts
checks.command:
bash scripts/selfhost-config.test.sh
bash scripts/worktree-db.test.sh
bash scripts/dev-env.test.sh
bash scripts/perf-compare.test.sh
node scripts/generate-reserved-slugs.mjs
git diff --exit-code -- packages/core/paths/reserved-slugs.ts
bash scripts/helm-config.test.sh
bash scripts/entrypoint.test.sh
bash scripts/makefile-build.test.sh

checks.name: mobile
checks.command: pnpm exec turbo typecheck lint test --force --filter=@multica/mobile
